# Apply Search/Replace

## Summary
Host command — apply search/replace blocks to file contents. The format is:
╔═══ SEARCH ════╗
[original code to find]
╠═══════════════╣
[new code to replace with]
╚═══ REPLACE ═══╝
. Available to
cards and commands via the runtime loader, and to AI assistant rooms as a
tool.

## Example
```ts
import ApplySearchReplaceBlockTool from '@cardstack/boxel-host/commands/apply-search-replace-block';

let result = await new ApplySearchReplaceBlockTool(commandContext).execute({
  /* input fields */
} as any);
```
`commandContext` comes from `@context.commandContext` inside any card
format. In an AI room the same tool is invoked by name (action verb: Apply).
